items.title: Wait for Tesla to Fall to $320: Patience Over FOMO is Paramount

items.title: SpaceX just caught a spaceship out of the sky
items.summary: SpaceX's Ship 42 circled the Earth 14 times, then came back 22.5 hours later and was caught mid-air by the same tower it launched from, the first catch of a spaceship returning from orbit. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through the flight and why it matters for Starlink, AI satellites and SpaceX's compute business.

items.title: Latest News In Energy Transition - Statkraft Boosts UK Grid Stability With First Battery System
items.summary: Statkraft has successfully launched its first grid-forming battery energy storage system at the Neilston Greener Grid Park in Scotland, marking a significant stride in supporting the renewable energy transition. This development underscores the evolving need for grid infrastructure, such as batteries and flexibility solutions, to optimize the utilization of renewable energy sources. As the UK becomes a pivotal market for these advancements, projects like Neilston provide crucial stability...

items.title: Nvidia Board Reportedly Rules Out Jensen Huang Return Despite Growing Support Campaign
items.summary: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) is not considering reinstating former Chief Executive Jensen Huang, according to a Reuters report citing three people familiar with the matter, despite a campaign supporting his return following his resignation last week. More than 180,200 people have signed a petition calling for Huang to be reinstated, with supporters including Tesla and SpaceX Chief Executive Elon Musk and thousands of individuals identifying themselves as Nvidia employees.
